repairs.finding: The trainer used one deterministic embedding per training target and did not train on multiple views, a view mean, or an agreement term.
repairs.change: Added two independently feature-dropped views per training batch, reconstructs the original baseline embedding target from the view mean, and adds the weighted agreement regularizer. Validation/evaluation rows remain outside the training-view dataset.
repairs.verification: Inspected the updated training loop: it forms [M,B,D] views, runs quantization for view codes, computes the mean-view baseline RQ loss, and adds uncertainty_agreement before backward. Full training was not run.

repairs.finding: The agreement helper's detached variance and discrete-only code mismatch had no gradient path.
repairs.change: Kept hard variance-weighted code disagreement as the forward objective while using a variance-weighted pairwise latent-distance straight-through surrogate for gradients to the encoder outputs.
repairs.verification: The gradient smoke test produced a finite loss with requires_grad=True and finite nonzero input gradient norm (13.066496); py_compile passed for train_rqvae.py and uncertainty.py.

repairs.finding: The proposal requires metadata-text dropout views; available tree inputs contain only precomputed embedding vectors, and no validation lambda-selection path/data is available.
repairs.change: Used independent embedding-feature dropout only, preserving the available input contract. Did not invent metadata or validation records.
repairs.verification: The tree has no dataset files under dataset/, and the trainer's configured source is sentence_t5.npy plus the training parquet. This requirement remains only partially implemented.

remaining_issues: Metadata text is not supplied in this tree, so stochastic views are embedding-feature dropout rather than corrupted metadata text.
Lambda is currently a fixed constant; no validation-based lambda selection was implemented because no validation data/split is supplied by the existing trainer.
